speaker: alse_pinder
text: The mistress says you were so still she feared you were dead.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Somebody is. Tell her I'm well.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I'll tell her. Will you come down, sir? She will not hold a dinner forever.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming down. Tell her I did not walk once, and I am well.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I heard. Come down. I asked if you were dead, and you are not.
